name: product-surface-v1
description: Certified product-surface delivery capability. Bound when a generated app fails goal-attainment / delivery review. Guides regeneration toward a shippable independent app that satisfies GoalSpec success criteria — not a demo dump. Core must not publish until the Goal is attained or explicitly terminated.

generation_guidance: Validate against GoalSpec success_criteria and first_deliverable before claiming done.
Ship a designed product UI (stylesheet + layout + typography), never browser-default dumps.
If observed evidence exists, render it as the primary product content with clear source labels and outbound links.
If the Goal cannot be met with current capabilities, fail closed for publish and let Core organize more capabilities — do not emit an unreliable surface.
